name: Total glucosides of paeony
short: Trials report diarrhoea or stomach discomfort as the commonest side effects, with no severe events; added to standard drugs it did not raise adverse reactions.
text: In a meta-analysis of 9 randomised trials in primary Sjögren's syndrome, the most common adverse events with total glucosides of paeony were diarrhoea or gastrointestinal discomfort, and no severe adverse events were reported. In a meta-analysis of lupus trials, adding it to conventional treatment did not increase adverse reactions. In rheumatoid arthritis, a meta-analysis of 39 studies found that adding it to standard drugs was associated with fewer liver adverse effects and less leukopenia in pooled analyses, mainly when combined with leflunomide or with methotrexate plus leflunomide (methotrexate-only subgroups were not significant); these data come from add-on use, not use on its own. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
